findings.title: Task completion before the original result drops the continuation
findings.description: A task can finish before the original turn’s result while its notification still triggers a subsequent parent continuation. The empty ledger then causes dispatch to return prematurely. Reproduced with the project’s scripted client: start → notification → original result returned `"Waiting"` without reading the queued `"Artifact written"` continuation. Track pending continuations or authoritative session-idle state, and add this ordering as a regression test.

findings.title: Background timeout also interrupts active parent continuations
findings.description: The timeout remains enabled throughout `_read_turn`, even after a notification clears the last background task and the parent resumes foreground work. A slow parent operation can therefore cause dispatch to return partial text as success while that operation remains unfinished. Reproduced with a notification followed by a delayed continuation: dispatch returned `"Waiting\nWorking"` before its final result and logged a timeout with no agents to stop. Disable the background-only timer once no tracked tasks remain, and test a slow continuation after task completion.
